mapper.sql: id, warehouse_id, location_id, sku_id, batch_no, qty, locked_qty, frozen_qty, available_qty, version, production_date, expiry_date, inbound_time, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory (warehouse_id, location_id, sku_id, batch_no, qty, locked_qty, frozen_qty, version, inbound_time, deleted) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{locationId}, #{skuId}, #{batchNo}, 0, 0, 0, 0, NOW(3), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET qty = #{qty}, locked_qty = #{lockedQty}, frozen_qty = #{frozenQty}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
